attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, m.name AS method_name FROM code.class_bases AS cb INNER JOIN code.symbols AS c ON c.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id INNER JOIN code.files AS f ON f.file_id = c.file_id INNER JOIN code.symbols AS m ON m.file_id = c.file_id AND m.qualname = c.qualname || '.' || m.name AND m.kind = 'method' AND m.is_public = TRUE WHERE cb.base_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py::SQLDatabase' AND f.is_test = FALSE AND c.kind = 'class' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.symbols AS bm WHERE bm.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND bm.qualname = 'SQLDatabase.' || m.name AND bm.kind = 'method') ORDER BY class_symbol_id, method_name

request:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This lists each production connector class that directly inherits from SQLDatabase, excluding classes defined in test files. For those classes, it reports public methods defined in the class body whose names are not also defined by SQLDatabase. Results are deduplicated to one row per class-method pair and ordered by class symbol and method name.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, m.name AS method_name FROM code.class_bases AS cb INNER JOIN code.symbols AS c ON c.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id INNER JOIN code.files AS f ON f.file_id = c.file_id INNER JOIN code.symbols AS m ON m.file_id = c.file_id AND m.qualname = c.qualname || '.' || m.name AND m.kind = 'method' AND m.is_public = TRUE WHERE cb.base_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py::SQLDatabase' AND f.is_test = FALSE AND c.kind = 'class' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.symbols AS bm WHERE bm.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND bm.qualname = 'SQLDatabase.' || m.name AND bm.kind = 'method') ORDER BY class_symbol_id, method_name
